notes.title: Early Playtest Set for June 13
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your continued support and excitement around the demo. We’ve wrapped up the core content and completed several rounds of internal testing. However, based on your feedback, we’ve identified areas—particularly around interactions and audio—that still need refinement.

To make sure the experience lives up to expectations, we’ve decided to take two more weeks to polish things further. We know delays are never fun, but we believe it’s worth taking the time to deliver something truly great—not just “good enough.”

We really appreciate your patience and understanding. Your support motivates us every day, and we’re doing our best to make that wait worthwhile. We’ll be sharing new demo footage later this week to keep you in the loop.

Thanks again—and we can’t wait to share more with you soon!

🕹️[b][h3]About the Early playtest[/h3][/b]
What’s included in the current demo:
[list]
[*] Playable heroine with mastery over powerful magic
[*] Face off against the first boss
[*] Unlock both Fire and Ice skills and builds
[*] Loot gear all the way up to Mythic-tier rarity
[*] Discover unique builds—gear and skills interact to unlock new playstyles.
[/list]
Playtest availability:
[list]
[*] The early playtest will continue to be updated until we’re ready to release the official public demo. (Note: playtest updates are heavily driven by player feedback, so expect frequent changes to gear, skills, and progression. Save data may be wiped between versions.)
[/list]
Playtest goals:
[list]
[*] Test the game loop (visuals, audio, controls, difficulty, character and gear progression, etc.);
[*] Identify bugs that may appear at scale (crashes, lag, lost items, etc.).
[/list]
You’re the perfect fit if you:
[list]
[*] Are open to playing an unfinished version and willing to tolerate instability while providing honest feedback;
[*] Use OBS or similar tools to record gameplay or bugs and share them with our team/community.
[/list]
How to Join：
1️⃣ Add to Your Steam Wishlist!
2️⃣ Join our Discord
3️⃣ DM the admin your Steam Friend Code (Profile → "Add Friend" → Friend code)
(You'll receive the @PlayTester role upon approval)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515355/c415580b363664ed167cccb4ca044fade32718a9.png[/img]

We’re incredibly grateful for players like you.

-Darkfallen Dev

notes.title: Playtest Delay – Thank You for Your Patience!
notes.content:
[b][/b][b]To Our Anticipated Survivors,[/b]

We want to thank all our anticipated Survivors for your patience. Our original goal was to launch the playtest in mid-May, but to ensure a smoother and more polished experience, we’re pushing it back just a bit — [b]to the end of the month[/b]. The build is nearly ready, with only a few final bugs left to squash.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. We can’t wait for you to experience the game once everything is polished and ready for you to dive in!

[previewyoutube=A4k9ESqqfwY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]▌What’s in the Early Playtest [/b]
[olist]
[*] Playable heroine with mastery over powerful magic
[*] Face off against the first boss
[*] Unlock both Fire and Ice skills and builds
[*] Loot gear all the way up to Mythic-tier rarity
[/olist]
[b]▌Development Roadmap
▶ Free Demo (Coming Soon)[/b]
[olist]
[*] Explore randomized maps with events, destructible objects, hidden treasures, and relics
[*] Add Lightning skills and synergy combos
[*] Loot up to equip gear
[*] Unlock the Talent System for custom builds
[*] Encounter new enemies and bosses
[*] Discover Ultimate Skills
[*] Customize difficulty with scalable challenge levels
[/olist]
[b]▶ Early Access Launch[/b]
[olist]
[*] New Playable Classes: Warrior & Hunter
[*] Introduce new skill categories: Curse, Holy, and Shadow
[*] Unlock crafting mechanics and equipment upgrading
[*] Discover and equip powerful Relics
[*] Loot Unique-tier gear and chase top builds
[*] More difficulty modes and an Endless Survival mode
[*] Expand map content and random events
[*] Summoning system and combat-ready pet companions
[/olist]

[b]▌Playtest Goals[/b]
1.Evaluate whether the game loop is well-designed (graphics, music, controls, difficulty, skills, equipment progression, etc.)
2.Identify potential bugs that may arise during large-scale testing (crashes, lag, item loss, etc.)

[b]To those willing to brave this unstable build:[/b]
1.Be patient with possible instability and provide honest feedback.
2.Understand that content is still being updated, so please be patient with incomplete features.
3.Use tools like OBS to record gameplay or any bug encounters and share the clips with the group.

We sincerely apologize again for the delayed release.

- Dev Team

notes.title: [Important Announcement] Game Rename
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We’re updating our game’s title from "Vanyar Survivors" to "Darkfallen Survivors" to avoid potential trademark conflicts.

Key Notes:

[list]
[*] This is [b]only a name change[/b] – all planned content and features remain the same.
[*] The game’s release timeline and development progress are [b]unaffected[/b].
[/list]

We appreciate your support as we prepare for launch! For updates, join our [url=https://discord.gg/FWREFjNeEw]Discord[/url] .

— SuperLimber Gaming
